text:
maria: Heads-up — deploying payments-service v2.3.0 today 16:00 PT. I'm the deploy lead. Quick runbook spot-check and owner pings before we start.
jon: Ack. Can you confirm backout toggle name and DB migration rollback plan?
maria: Backout toggle: `payments_v2_enable` (LaunchDarkly). If we need to abort, flip to `off`. DB: online migration `20260317_add_index` with safe index build; rollback is a drop-index script stored in infra/migrations/rollback_20260317.sql. Migration runs after canary is healthy.
kevin: Smoke checklist I ran locally: create payment, refund, webhook delivery, retry path. Link to quick runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/payments-deploy :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: preflight check — canary capacity ok, infra health checks pass, build artifact payments:v2.3.0 available. CI smoke job green.
sylvia: Who's on-call for rollback execution? If canary fails we should: 1) flip FF off, 2) revert image to payments:v2.2.1, 3) run rollback DB cleanup if necessary. Jon, can you own the coord?
jon: I'll own rollback coordination and will watch the metrics. Primary signals: error-rate (5xx), p99 latency, failed webhook count. Alert threshold: 3x baseline sustained for 5m -> trigger rollback.
maria: Canary rollout plan: 5% for 15m, then 25% for 10m, then full. Abort criteria: any critical smoke test failure in first 15m or >2% user-facing errors. Kevin — can you run the smoke script when canary is up?
kevin: Yes. I'll run `./smoke.sh --env=canary --cases=core,refund,webhook` and post results.
deploy-bot: Reminder — metrics pipeline toggle active. Live dashboard: https://dash.redwood/deployments/payments-v2.3 (streaming enabled).
sylvia: I've reserved 16:00-16:30 PT on my calendar. On-call is @matt-eng (pager duty). I can flip the FF immediately if Jon asks.
maria: OK final ack: react with :white_check_mark: when ready to proceed.
kevin: :white_check_mark:
jon: :white_check_mark:
sylvia: :white_check_mark:
